newsitem.title: USA: Serologicals buys Nations for $14.5 mln.
newsitem.headline: Serologicals buys Nations for $14.5 mln.

text.p: Serologicals Corp said Friday it has acquired Nations Biologics Inc and its affiliates for about $14.5 million in cash and notes, plus contingent consideration based primarily upon the profitability of Nations in 1997.
The acquisition of the Nations brings the total number of donor centers owned and operated by Serologicals to 58.

Serologicals said in 1996, that Nations recorded about $9.0 million in revenues. However, due to internal growth and acquisitions in 1996, the company expects the revenue of the 16 acquired donor centers will exceed $13.0 million in calendar 1997.

Nations's 16 donor centers specialize in the collection of antibodies used to produce intravenous immuneglobulin, which is used to treat patients with suppressed immune systems and specific immune globulins to treat cytomegalovirus and respiratory syncytial virus .
Serologicals is a leading worldwide provider of specialty human antibody-based products and services to major healthcare companies
